manifest.description: Reports what the reader misses on an article, and builds a pack to fix it.

settings.autoSignalsHint: Hodi notes articles blocked, too short or with page leftovers

dialog.title: Report a problem
dialog.introStart: Tick what is wrong. Hodi keeps
dialog.introKept: the original page and its extraction
dialog.failed: The report could not be sent.
dialog.gone: This article is no longer in Hodi.
dialog.captureFailed: The screenshot could not be sent.
dialog.removeMessage: It leaves the list and your next pack.

list.title: Already reported
list.intro: What you reported on this article. Something else wrong? Report it too.

errors.tooBig: This image is too big (5 MB at most).
errors.notAnImage: This file is not a PNG or JPG image.

page.title: Diagnostic
page.intro: What you reported on your sources, and what Hodi spotted on its own. Only you see it.
page.emptyText: Report an article from the reader, under its text.
page.clearHint: Once the pack is sent and fixed
page.clearMessage: Reports, kept pages and screenshots are deleted for good.
